deadline.value: No closing date is given on the Earth Sciences PhD page.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the Earth Sciences PhD page.

supervisor.value: You must contact and secure a supervisor before you apply.
supervisor.quote: Before applying applicants will need to have contacted and secured a supervisor in order to apply for your research project.

funding.value: The page says studentships support PhD research but does not say how many students are funded.
funding.quote: PhD research studies are supported by Research Council, industrial and university studentships.

entry_route.value: A good first degree or a Master's in a cognate subject is accepted, so direct entry from a bachelor's is possible.
entry_route.quote: A good first degree or masters in a cognate discipline to Earth Science, and relevant to the proposed research project.

notes: A research proposal is required at the point of application. Global Environmental Change is one of the department's three research themes. Bench fees of up to GBP 6,000 a year can apply to some projects.
